Travel to Dire Maul to acquire a Felvine.de: Reist nach Dire Maul, besorgt einen Felvine Seed von Alzzin the Wildshaper, ein Ancient Memento von Prince Tortheldrin und einen Earthstone Diamond Pinky Ring von King Gordok und bringt sie zu Pix Xizzix in Booty Bay.
Travel to Dire Maul to acquire a Felvine.es: Viaja a Dire Maul, consigue una Felvine Seed de Alzzin the Wildshaper, un Ancient Memento de Prince Tortheldrin y un Earthstone Diamond Pinky Ring de King Gordok, y llévalos a Pix Xizzix en Booty Bay.
Travel to Dire Maul to acquire a Felvine.fr: Rendez-vous à Dire Maul pour obtenir une Felvine Seed d'Alzzin the Wildshaper, un Ancient Memento de Prince Tortheldrin et un Earthstone Diamond Pinky Ring de King Gordok, puis apportez-les à Pix Xizzix à Booty Bay.
Travel to Dire Maul to acquire a Felvine.pt: Vá a Dire Maul para obter uma Felvine Seed de Alzzin the Wildshaper, um Ancient Memento de Prince Tortheldrin e um Earthstone Diamond Pinky Ring de King Gordok, e leve-os para Pix Xizzix em Booty Bay.
Travel to Dire Maul to acquire a Felvine.ru: Отправляйтесь в Dire Maul, добудьте Felvine Seed у Alzzin the Wildshaper, Ancient Memento у Prince Tortheldrin и Earthstone Diamond Pinky Ring у King Gordok и принесите их Pix Xizzix в Booty Bay.
Travel to Dire Maul to acquire a Felvine.zh: 前往 Dire Maul，从 Alzzin the Wildshaper 处取得 Felvine Seed，从 Prince Tortheldrin 处取得 Ancient Memento，从 King Gordok 处取得 Earthstone Diamond Pinky Ring，交给 Booty Bay 的 Pix Xizzix。

Travel to Krol'dok Stronghold and slay Z.de: Reist nach Krol'dok Stronghold und tötet Zalfan Moonshadow.
Travel to Krol'dok Stronghold and slay Z.es: Viaja a Krol'dok Stronghold y mata a Zalfan Moonshadow.
Travel to Krol'dok Stronghold and slay Z.fr: Rendez-vous à Krol'dok Stronghold et tuez Zalfan Moonshadow.
Travel to Krol'dok Stronghold and slay Z.pt: Vá a Krol'dok Stronghold e mate Zalfan Moonshadow.
Travel to Krol'dok Stronghold and slay Z.ru: Отправляйтесь в Krol'dok Stronghold и убейте Zalfan Moonshadow.
Travel to Krol'dok Stronghold and slay Z.zh: 前往 Krol'dok Stronghold 杀死 Zalfan Moonshadow。

Travel to the Dwarven District in Stormw.de: Reist in den Zwergendistrikt von Stormwind und findet einen Ingenieur, der helfen kann.
Travel to the Dwarven District in Stormw.es: Viaja al Distrito de los Enanos de Stormwind y busca un ingeniero que pueda ayudar.
Travel to the Dwarven District in Stormw.fr: Rendez-vous dans le quartier des Nains de Stormwind et trouvez un ingénieur qui pourra vous aider.
Travel to the Dwarven District in Stormw.pt: Vá ao Distrito dos Anões de Stormwind e encontre um engenheiro que possa ajudar.
Travel to the Dwarven District in Stormw.ru: Отправляйтесь в Дворфийский квартал Stormwind и найдите инженера, который сможет помочь.
Travel to the Dwarven District in Stormw.zh: 前往 Stormwind 矮人区，找一位能帮忙的工程师。

Travel to the Wetlands and meet the Deat.de: Reist ins Wetlands und trefft den Deathstalker Agent in den Hügeln über dem Lager der Dragonmaw.
Travel to the Wetlands and meet the Deat.es: Viaja a Wetlands y reúnete con el Deathstalker Agent en las colinas sobre el campamento Dragonmaw.
Travel to the Wetlands and meet the Deat.fr: Rendez-vous dans les Wetlands et retrouvez le Deathstalker Agent dans les collines au-dessus du camp Dragonmaw.
Travel to the Wetlands and meet the Deat.pt: Vá a Wetlands e encontre o Deathstalker Agent nas colinas acima do acampamento Dragonmaw.
Travel to the Wetlands and meet the Deat.ru: Отправляйтесь в Wetlands и встретьтесь с Deathstalker Agent на холмах над лагерем Dragonmaw.
Travel to the Wetlands and meet the Deat.zh: 前往 Wetlands，在 Dragonmaw 营地上方的山丘与 Deathstalker Agent 会面。

Use the Divination Scryer in the heart o.de: Benutzt den Divination Scryer in der Mitte des Kellers des Great Ossuary in der Scholomance. Er ruft Geister herbei, die Ihr bekämpfen müsst. Besiegt Ihr sie, erscheint der Todesritter Darkreaver; besiegt ihn. Bringt Darkreaver's Head zu Eldrun Stormbreaker in den Forlorn Caverns in Ironforge.
Use the Divination Scryer in the heart o.es: Usa el Divination Scryer en el centro del sótano del Great Ossuary en Scholomance. Invocará espíritus contra los que debes luchar. Al derrotarlos aparecerá el caballero de la muerte Darkreaver; derrótalo. Lleva Darkreaver's Head a Eldrun Stormbreaker en las Forlorn Caverns de Ironforge.
Use the Divination Scryer in the heart o.fr: Utilisez le Divination Scryer au cœur du sous-sol du Great Ossuary de Scholomance. Il fera apparaître des esprits que vous devrez combattre. Les vaincre invoquera le chevalier de la mort Darkreaver ; vainquez-le. Apportez Darkreaver's Head à Eldrun Stormbreaker dans les Forlorn Caverns d'Ironforge.
Use the Divination Scryer in the heart o.pt: Use o Divination Scryer no centro do porão do Great Ossuary em Scholomance. Ele trará espíritos que você precisa enfrentar. Derrotá-los invocará o cavaleiro da morte Darkreaver; derrote-o. Leve Darkreaver's Head para Eldrun Stormbreaker nas Forlorn Caverns, em Ironforge.
Use the Divination Scryer in the heart o.ru: Используйте Divination Scryer в центре подвала Great Ossuary в Scholomance. Он вызовет духов, с которыми нужно сразиться. Победа над ними призовёт рыцаря смерти Darkreaver; победите его. Принесите Darkreaver's Head Eldrun Stormbreaker в Forlorn Caverns в Ironforge.
Use the Divination Scryer in the heart o.zh: 在 Scholomance 的 Great Ossuary 地下室中央使用 Divination Scryer，召唤出你必须战斗的灵魂。击败它们后会召唤死亡骑士 Darkreaver；击败他。把 Darkreaver's Head 交给 Ironforge 的 Forlorn Caverns 中的 Eldrun Stormbreaker。

Use the Divination Scryer in the heart o.de: Benutzt den Divination Scryer in der Mitte des Kellers des Great Ossuary in der Scholomance. Er ruft Geister herbei, über die Ihr richten müsst. Besiegt Ihr sie, erscheint der Todesritter Darkreaver. Besiegt ihn und holt die verlorene Seele des gefallenen Streitrosses zurück. Gebt den Spirit of Retribution...
Use the Divination Scryer in the heart o.es: Usa el Divination Scryer en el centro del sótano del Great Ossuary en Scholomance. Invocará espíritus que debes juzgar. Al derrotarlos aparecerá el caballero de la muerte Darkreaver. Derrótalo y recupera el alma perdida del corcel caído. Entrega el Spirit of Retribution...
Use the Divination Scryer in the heart o.fr: Utilisez le Divination Scryer au cœur du sous-sol du Great Ossuary de Scholomance. Il fera apparaître des esprits que vous devrez juger. Les vaincre invoquera le chevalier de la mort Darkreaver. Vainquez-le et reprenez l'âme perdue du destrier déchu. Donnez le Spirit of Retribution...
Use the Divination Scryer in the heart o.pt: Use o Divination Scryer no centro do porão do Great Ossuary em Scholomance. Ele trará espíritos que você precisa julgar. Derrotá-los invocará o cavaleiro da morte Darkreaver. Derrote-o e recupere a alma perdida do corcel caído. Entregue o Spirit of Retribution...
Use the Divination Scryer in the heart o.ru: Используйте Divination Scryer в центре подвала Great Ossuary в Scholomance. Он вызовет духов, которых нужно рассудить. Победа над ними призовёт рыцаря смерти Darkreaver. Победите его и верните потерянную душу павшего скакуна. Отдайте Spirit of Retribution...
Use the Divination Scryer in the heart o.zh: 在 Scholomance 的 Great Ossuary 地下室中央使用 Divination Scryer，召唤出你必须审判的灵魂。击败它们后会召唤死亡骑士 Darkreaver。击败他，夺回陨落战马失落的灵魂。把 Spirit of Retribution...

Use the SI:7 Disguise Kit to eavesdrop o.de: Benutzt das SI:7 Disguise Kit, um Jaina und ihren engsten Kreis im Theramore Mage Tower zu belauschen.
Use the SI:7 Disguise Kit to eavesdrop o.es: Usa el SI:7 Disguise Kit para escuchar a escondidas a Jaina y su círculo íntimo en la Theramore Mage Tower.
Use the SI:7 Disguise Kit to eavesdrop o.fr: Utilisez le SI:7 Disguise Kit pour espionner Jaina et ses proches dans la Theramore Mage Tower.
Use the SI:7 Disguise Kit to eavesdrop o.pt: Use o SI:7 Disguise Kit para espiar Jaina e seu círculo íntimo na Theramore Mage Tower.
Use the SI:7 Disguise Kit to eavesdrop o.ru: Используйте SI:7 Disguise Kit, чтобы подслушать Jaina и её приближённых в Theramore Mage Tower.
Use the SI:7 Disguise Kit to eavesdrop o.zh: 使用 SI:7 Disguise Kit，在 Theramore Mage Tower 偷听 Jaina 和她的亲信。

Use the Well Water Sample Kit to collect.de: Nehmt mit dem Well Water Sample Kit Proben aus den Brunnen von Jansen Stead und Molsen Farm.
Use the Well Water Sample Kit to collect.es: Usa el Well Water Sample Kit para tomar muestras de los pozos de Jansen Stead y Molsen Farm.
Use the Well Water Sample Kit to collect.fr: Utilisez le Well Water Sample Kit pour prélever des échantillons dans les puits de Jansen Stead et de Molsen Farm.
Use the Well Water Sample Kit to collect.pt: Use o Well Water Sample Kit para coletar amostras dos poços de Jansen Stead e Molsen Farm.
Use the Well Water Sample Kit to collect.ru: С помощью Well Water Sample Kit возьмите пробы из колодцев на Jansen Stead и Molsen Farm.
Use the Well Water Sample Kit to collect.zh: 使用 Well Water Sample Kit 从 Jansen Stead 和 Molsen Farm 的水井采集样本。

Use the hide and charcoal to create a ru.de: Fertigt mit Leder und Holzkohle einen Abrieb der Tafel Third Troll Legend an.
Use the hide and charcoal to create a ru.es: Usa la piel y el carbón para hacer un calco de la tablilla Third Troll Legend.
Use the hide and charcoal to create a ru.fr: Utilisez le cuir et le charbon pour faire un estampage de la tablette Third Troll Legend.
Use the hide and charcoal to create a ru.pt: Use o couro e o carvão para fazer uma cópia da tábua Third Troll Legend.
Use the hide and charcoal to create a ru.ru: Сделайте шкурой и углём оттиск таблички Third Troll Legend.
Use the hide and charcoal to create a ru.zh: 用皮和木炭拓印 Third Troll Legend 石板。

Use the hide and charcoal to create rubb.fr: Utilisez le cuir et le charbon pour faire des estampages des tablettes de la Drowned City.
Use the hide and charcoal to create rubb.pt: Use o couro e o carvão para fazer cópias das tábuas da Drowned City.
Use the hide and charcoal to create rubb.ru: Сделайте шкурой и углём оттиски табличек в Drowned City.
Use the hide and charcoal to create rubb.zh: 用皮和木炭拓印 Drowned City 中的石板。

Use the hints in Gregory's Note to deter.de: Findet mit den Hinweisen in Gregory's Note heraus, wo die magischen Zutaten für das Ritual zu finden sind. Dafür braucht Ihr die Hilfe von Verbündeten.
Use the hints in Gregory's Note to deter.es: Usa las pistas de Gregory's Note para averiguar dónde encontrar los componentes mágicos del ritual. Necesitarás la ayuda de aliados.
Use the hints in Gregory's Note to deter.fr: Servez-vous des indices de Gregory's Note pour savoir où trouver les composants magiques du rituel. Vous aurez besoin de l'aide d'alliés.
Use the hints in Gregory's Note to deter.pt: Use as pistas de Gregory's Note para descobrir onde encontrar os componentes mágicos do ritual. Você vai precisar da ajuda de aliados.
Use the hints in Gregory's Note to deter.ru: По подсказкам из Gregory's Note выясните, где найти магические компоненты для ритуала. Для этого понадобится помощь союзников.
Use the hints in Gregory's Note to deter.zh: 根据 Gregory's Note 中的线索，查出仪式所需的魔法材料在哪里。你需要盟友的帮助。

Use the note provided by Mason Connery t.de: Findet mit der Notiz von Mason Connery seinen versteckten Schatz.
Use the note provided by Mason Connery t.es: Usa la nota de Mason Connery para encontrar su tesoro escondido.
Use the note provided by Mason Connery t.fr: Servez-vous de la note de Mason Connery pour trouver son trésor caché.
Use the note provided by Mason Connery t.pt: Use o bilhete de Mason Connery para encontrar o tesouro escondido dele.
Use the note provided by Mason Connery t.ru: По записке Mason Connery найдите его спрятанное сокровище.
Use the note provided by Mason Connery t.zh: 根据 Mason Connery 留下的字条找到他藏起来的宝藏。

Venture to Maraudon and recover a Vial o.de: Reist nach Maraudon, holt eine Vial of Earth Song Water und bringt sie zu Woodwyrd in den Forlorn Gardens in Desolace.
Venture to Maraudon and recover a Vial o.es: Ve a Maraudon, recupera un Vial of Earth Song Water y llévaselo a Woodwyrd en los Forlorn Gardens de Desolace.
Venture to Maraudon and recover a Vial o.fr: Rendez-vous à Maraudon, récupérez une Vial of Earth Song Water et rapportez-la à Woodwyrd dans les Forlorn Gardens, en Desolace.
Venture to Maraudon and recover a Vial o.pt: Vá a Maraudon, recupere um Vial of Earth Song Water e leve-o para Woodwyrd nos Forlorn Gardens, em Desolace.
Venture to Maraudon and recover a Vial o.ru: Отправляйтесь в Maraudon, добудьте Vial of Earth Song Water и отнесите его Woodwyrd в Forlorn Gardens в Desolace.
Venture to Maraudon and recover a Vial o.zh: 前往 Maraudon 取得 Vial of Earth Song Water，交给 Desolace 的 Forlorn Gardens 的 Woodwyrd。

Venture to Razorfen Downs and acquire Vi.de: Reist nach Razorfen Downs, besorgt Virulent Blood of Agamaggan und bringt es zu Kog'thug the Brave im Bristleback Retreat in Desolace. Kog'thug erinnert daran, dass das Blood of Agamaggan aus Razorfen Kraul nicht ausreicht.
Venture to Razorfen Downs and acquire Vi.es: Ve a Razorfen Downs, consigue Virulent Blood of Agamaggan y llévasela a Kog'thug the Brave en Bristleback Retreat, en Desolace. Kog'thug recuerda que la Blood of Agamaggan de Razorfen Kraul no bastaría.
Venture to Razorfen Downs and acquire Vi.fr: Rendez-vous à Razorfen Downs, procurez-vous du Virulent Blood of Agamaggan et rapportez-le à Kog'thug the Brave au Bristleback Retreat, en Desolace. Kog'thug rappelle que le Blood of Agamaggan de Razorfen Kraul ne suffirait pas.
Venture to Razorfen Downs and acquire Vi.pt: Vá a Razorfen Downs, obtenha Virulent Blood of Agamaggan e leve-o para Kog'thug the Brave em Bristleback Retreat, em Desolace. Kog'thug lembra que o Blood of Agamaggan de Razorfen Kraul não serviria.
Venture to Razorfen Downs and acquire Vi.ru: Отправляйтесь в Razorfen Downs, добудьте Virulent Blood of Agamaggan и отнесите её Kog'thug the Brave в Bristleback Retreat в Desolace. Kog'thug напоминает, что Blood of Agamaggan из Razorfen Kraul не подойдёт.
Venture to Razorfen Downs and acquire Vi.zh: 前往 Razorfen Downs 取得 Virulent Blood of Agamaggan，交给 Desolace 的 Bristleback Retreat 的 Kog'thug the Brave。Kog'thug 提醒说，Razorfen Kraul 里的 Blood of Agamaggan 是不够的。
